fact: The World Bank says the new Inter-Ministerial Digital and AI Coordination Committee and the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) have the mandate to lead Seychelles' digital transformation agenda, with the Digital and AI Strategy still to be operationalised; the report's publication date is used as no other date is given.

A consultant on the team drafting Seychelles' National Digital & AI Strategy 2026-2031 says the national validation workshop concluded in the two weeks before 10 July 2026, with no adoption stated; the strategy covers digital infrastructure, government services, AI, skills, innovation and the digital economy.
The strategy under development is titled National Digital & AI Strategy 2026-2031, per the consultant's post of 10 July 2026.
